title: Can Rabbits Eat Honeydew Melon?
description: It does not replace advice from a rabbit-savvy vet. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems in pain or is suddenly unwell, contact a vet…
body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk blog article block
Page: Can Rabbits Eat Honeydew Melon?
How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit the blog page/post.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old article content with everything below.

Notes:
- No custom header/nav or footer included.
- Internal links use root-relative URLs.
- Uses the same visual style as the RabbitCare homepage and rabbit food guides.
-->

<section class="rchm-page alignfull" id="can-rabbits-eat-honeydew-melon">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-brown: #8a6246;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-white: #ffffff;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-radius-lg: 24px;
      --rc-radius-md: 16px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rchm-page,
    .rchm-page * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main { background: #fef4f0 !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image { display: none !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * { margin-block-start: 0 !important; }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rchm-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rchm-page a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }

    .rchm-page a:focus-visible {
      outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9);
      outline-offset: 4px;
      border-radius: 10px;
    }

    .rchm-wrap { width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }
    .rchm-narrow { width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }

    .rchm-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rchm-pill::before { content: "✦"; color: var(--rc-gold); }

    .rchm-btns {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 14px;
      align-items: center;
      margin-top: 30px;
    }

    .rchm-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rchm-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }

    .rchm-btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26);
    }

    .rchm-btn-secondary {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rchm-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rchm-hero-image-wrap {
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rchm-hero-cover { position: relative; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; }

    .rchm-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.68), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.24) 45%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.04)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rchm-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rchmFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rchm-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 720px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rchm-hero-title-overlay .rchm-pill {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rchm-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 6.5vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rchm-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rchm-hero-content {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
      gap: 34px;
      align-items: center;
      padding-top: 44px;
    }

    .rchm-breadcrumb {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rchm-breadcrumb a { color: var(--rc-sage-dark); }

    .rchm-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 1.0;
      letter-spacing: -0.05em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rchm-hero-subtitle {
      max-width: 720px;
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem);
    }

    .rchm-hero-card {
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 38px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rchm-hero-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      line-height: 1.18;
    }

    .rchm-hero-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rchm-hero-card li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      align-items: start;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rchm-hero-card li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rchm-quickbar { position: relative; z-index: 4; margin-top: 26px; }

    .rchm-quickbar-inner {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
    }

    .rchm-quick {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      min-height: 96px;
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rchm-quick:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14);
    }

    .rchm-quick-icon {
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      font-size: 2.35rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .rchm-quick strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      line-height: 1.15;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
    }

    .rchm-quick span span {
      display: block;
      margin-top: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .rchm-section { width: 100%; padding: 72px 0; position: relative; }

    .rchm-section-header {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 auto 32px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .rchm-section h2,
    .rchm-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rchm-section-header p {
      margin: 0 auto;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      max-width: 680px;
    }

    .rchm-article-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .rchm-content { display: grid; gap: 24px; }

    .rchm-panel {
      position: relative;
      padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px);
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 48px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rchm-panel::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      width: 190px;
      height: 190px;
      right: -82px;
      top: -92px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10);
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rchm-panel > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .rchm-panel h2 { margin-top: 0; }

    .rchm-panel h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.45rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rchm-panel p {
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.03rem;
    }

    .rchm-panel p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    .rchm-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 22px 0 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rchm-list li {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr;
      gap: 12px;
      align-items: start;
      padding: 15px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.9);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .rchm-list li::before {
      content: "✓";
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .rchm-treat-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rchm-treat-card {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rchm-treat-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15);
    }

    .rchm-treat-card b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.2rem;
    }

    .rchm-treat-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.22rem; }
    .rchm-treat-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rchm-warning {
      padding: 68px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rchm-warning-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 28px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px);
      border-radius: 42px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
    }

    .rchm-warning-card h2 { color: var(--rc-danger); }

    .rchm-warning-card p {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      font-size: 1.06rem;
    }

    .rchm-warning-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 12px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rchm-warning-list li {
      padding: 18px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--rc-danger-soft);
      color: #4a2823;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .rchm-warning-list strong {
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      color: var(--rc-danger);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .rchm-image-split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr;
      gap: 30px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .rchm-image-card { position: relative; min-height: 430px; }

    .rchm-image-card img {
      position: absolute;
      object-fit: cover;
      display: block;
      border: 10px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      transition: transform 0.35s ease;
    }

    .rchm-image-card img:hover { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03) !important; }

    .rchm-img-main {
      width: 78%;
      height: 340px;
      left: 0;
      top: 20px;
      border-radius: 42px;
      transform: rotate(-2deg);
    }

    .rchm-img-small {
      width: 52%;
      height: 230px;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      border-radius: 34px;
      transform: rotate(4deg);
      object-fit: contain !important;
      background: #fff9ef;
    }

    .rchm-prep {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0));
    }

    .rchm-steps {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rchm-step {
      padding: 24px;
      border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rchm-step b {
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.15);
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
    }

    .rchm-step h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.16rem; }
    .rchm-step p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rchm-sidebar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 22px;
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .rchm-side-card {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 28px;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rchm-side-card h2 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      color: var(--rc-moss);
      font-size: 1.18rem;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .rchm-side-card ul {
      display: grid;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .rchm-side-card a {
      display: block;
      padding: 11px 12px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: #fff9ef;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-weight: 850;
      transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .rchm-side-card a:hover { transform: translateX(4px); background: #fff4d8; }

    .rchm-note {
      padding: 20px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold);
      color: var(--rc-muted);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rchm-note strong { color: var(--rc-moss); }

    .rchm-benefits-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .rchm-benefit {
      padding: 22px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08);
    }

    .rchm-benefit h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.15rem; }
    .rchm-benefit p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rchm-final { padding: 70px 0 42px; background: #fef4f0; }

    .rchm-final-box {
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px);
      border-radius: 46px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28, 48, 27, 0.92), rgba(58, 84, 49, 0.86)),
        url("/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-honeydew-melon.png");
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      color: #ffffff;
      box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .rchm-final-box .rchm-pill,
    .rchm-final-box h2,
    .rchm-final-box p {
      color: #ffffff;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    .rchm-final-box p {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      font-size: 1.08rem;
    }

    .rchm-final-box .rchm-btn-secondary {
      background: #ffffff;
      color: #2f4a2e;
      border: 2px solid #ffffff;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
      text-shadow: none;
    }

    .rchm-related {
      padding: 74px 0;
      background: #fff9ef;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      transform: none !important;
      animation: none !important;
    }

    .rchm-related,
    .rchm-related * {
      opacity: 1 !important;
      filter: none !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rchm-related .rchm-section-header {
      padding: 30px;
      border-radius: 34px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 54px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.14);
    }

    .rchm-related .rchm-section-header .rchm-pill { color: #4e6b45 !important; }

    .rchm-related .rchm-section-header h2 {
      color: #243320 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
    }

    .rchm-related .rchm-section-header p {
      color: #332d26 !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      text-shadow: none !important;
      font-weight: 650;
    }

    .rchm-related-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 28px;
    }

    .rchm-related-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr;
      gap: 15px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 24px;

            <span class="rchm-pill">Rabbit food guide</span>
            <h2>Honeydew is a mild, sweet melon that rabbits can eat in small amounts</h2>
            <p>
              Honeydew melon is a smooth-skinned, pale green fleshed fruit that is a common sight in UK supermarkets and fruit bowls. If you have leftover honeydew and a curious rabbit, you may wonder whether it is safe to share a small piece. The answer is yes, honeydew flesh is safe for rabbits in small amounts as an occasional treat.
            </p>
            <p>
              Honeydew shares the same basic profile as cantaloupe: very high in water, naturally sweet, and best kept as a rare treat rather than a regular part of the vegetable rotation. The key differences from cantaloupe are its paler flesh, milder fragrance and slightly less intense sweetness, but it still warrants careful portioning. As always, the rind and seeds must be removed before feeding.
            </p>

          <section class="rchm-panel" id="safe">
            <span class="rchm-pill">Safe with correct preparation</span>
            <h2>Is honeydew melon safe for rabbits?</h2>
            <p>
              Yes, the pale green flesh of a ripe honeydew melon is safe for most healthy adult rabbits when offered in very small amounts. The rind should be removed entirely before feeding, as it is tough and waxy and much harder for a rabbit to digest than the soft flesh inside. The seeds should also be scooped out and discarded.
            </p>
            <p>
              Because honeydew is such a watery fruit, it is worth introducing it more gradually than drier treats. Even a small amount can loosen stools in a rabbit that is not used to it, so starting with a single small cube and giving a day before offering more is a sensible approach for any rabbit trying it for the first time.
            </p>
          </section>
        </article>

          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>Scoop out the seeds</strong>
            Remove all seeds from the centre cavity before portioning the flesh. The seeds are not acutely toxic but are unnecessary and best left out entirely.
          </li>

          <li>
            <strong>No juice, dried or processed melon</strong>
            Do not feed honeydew juice, melon-flavoured products, dried melon pieces or any tinned or sweetened melon. Only fresh, raw, ripe honeydew flesh with the rind and seeds removed is appropriate.

          <h2>Honeydew is a gentler melon treat than cantaloupe</h2>
          <p>
            Where cantaloupe has a bold fragrance that tends to attract rabbits before it even reaches them, honeydew's scent is more subtle. Some rabbits approach it with the same enthusiasm as any sweet fruit; others are more cautious or indifferent. Both responses are entirely normal.
          </p>
          <p>
            Honeydew's milder profile can actually make it a useful alternative for rabbits whose owners want to offer melon variety without always reaching for the more intensely sweet cantaloupe. The preparation steps are identical, rind off, seeds out, flesh cubed small, so switching between the two requires no change to routine.
          </p>

    <section class="rchm-section rchm-prep rchm-reveal" id="prepare">
      <div class="rchm-wrap">
        <div class="rchm-section-header">
          <span class="rchm-pill">Simple preparation</span>
          <h2>How to prepare honeydew melon for rabbits</h2>
          <p>
            Honeydew preparation follows exactly the same steps as cantaloupe, rind off, seeds out, flesh cubed small, leftovers removed promptly.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rchm-steps">
          <article class="rchm-step">
            <b>1</b>
            <h3>Choose ripe honeydew</h3>
            <p>Use a fresh, fully ripe honeydew with pale green, soft, fragrant flesh. Avoid underripe, watery or overripe fruit, and never use tinned or dried melon.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rchm-step">
            <b>2</b>
            <h3>Remove rind and seeds</h3>
            <p>Cut away the smooth waxy rind completely and scoop out all seeds from the centre. Check no rind remains on the edges of the flesh before portioning.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rchm-step">
            <b>3</b>
            <h3>Cut into small cubes</h3>
            <p>Slice the pale green flesh into small, clearly portioned cubes, roughly a teaspoon's worth in total. Do not offer a full wedge or large slice.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rchm-step">
            <b>4</b>
            <h3>Serve and remove promptly</h3>
            <p>Offer one or two cubes and remove any uneaten honeydew after about an hour, as soft moist melon spoils quickly in warm conditions.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="rchm-section rchm-reveal" id="benefits">
      <div class="rchm-wrap">
        <div class="rchm-section-header">
          <span class="rchm-pill">Treat benefits</span>
          <h2>Benefits and signs your rabbit enjoys honeydew</h2>
          <p>
            In the right amounts, honeydew can be a refreshing and gently sweet treat. Its milder profile compared to cantaloupe means reactions vary more between individual rabbits.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rchm-benefits-grid">
          <article class="rchm-benefit">
            <h3>A milder melon option</h3>
            <p>Honeydew's subtler sweetness makes it a useful alternative for owners who want to vary the melon treat without always using cantaloupe.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rchm-benefit">
            <h3>Vitamins and potassium</h3>
            <p>Honeydew provides vitamin C, B vitamins and potassium in small amounts, adding gentle variety to a diet built on hay and leafy greens.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rchm-benefit">
            <h3>Hydrating in tiny amounts</h3>
            <p>The high water content contributes a small amount of additional hydration, though it also means portions must remain very small to avoid loose stools.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rchm-benefit">
            <h3>Gentle bonding treat</h3>
            <p>For rabbits that enjoy it, honeydew can work as a calm positive interaction treat during quiet handling or grooming sessions.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rchm-benefit">
            <h3>Signs they enjoy it</h3>
            <p>Your rabbit may approach with interest, sniff carefully and then eat it willingly, or may simply ignore it. Indifference to honeydew is more common than with cantaloupe.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rchm-benefit">
            <h3>Remove leftovers quickly</h3>
            <p>Like cantaloupe, any uneaten honeydew should be removed from the enclosure within an hour to prevent spoilage in warm conditions.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>


    <section class="rchm-faq rchm-reveal" id="faqs" aria-label="Rabbit honeydew melon FAQs">
      <div class="rchm-narrow">
        <div class="rchm-panel">
          <div class="rchm-section-header">
            <span class="rchm-pill">FAQs</span>
            <h2>Rabbit honeydew melon FAQs</h2>
            <p>Quick answers to common questions about feeding honeydew melon to rabbits safely.</p>
          </div>

          <div class="rchm-faq-list">
            <details class="rchm-faq-item">
              <summary>Can rabbits eat honeydew melon safely?</summary>
              <p>Yes, rabbits can eat fresh honeydew melon flesh safely in very small amounts. It is high in water and natural sugar, so it should only be an occasional treat and should never replace hay, water, leafy greens or a balanced rabbit diet.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rchm-faq-item">
              <summary>Can rabbits eat honeydew melon rind?</summary>
              <p>No. Honeydew melon rind is tough, waxy and difficult for rabbits to digest. Always cut the rind away completely and feed only the soft pale green flesh.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rchm-faq-item">
              <summary>Can rabbits eat honeydew melon seeds?</summary>
              <p>Honeydew seeds should be removed before feeding. They are unnecessary and best avoided, so scoop out the seeds and only offer a tiny amount of fresh flesh.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rchm-faq-item">
              <summary>How much honeydew melon can a rabbit have?</summary>
              <p>A sensible guide is one or two very small cubes, roughly a teaspoon's worth in total, once a week at most for a healthy adult rabbit. Smaller rabbits should have even less.</p>
            </details>

            <details class="rchm-faq-item">
              <summary>Can baby rabbits eat honeydew melon?</summary>
              <p>Baby rabbits should not be given sugary fruit treats like honeydew melon. Young rabbits need an age-appropriate diet based around hay, suitable pellets and careful gradual introductions under appropriate guidance.</p>
            </details>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

        <span class="rchm-pill">Final thoughts</span>
        <h2>Honeydew melon can be a safe and refreshing occasional treat for rabbits</h2>
        <p>
          Rabbits can eat honeydew melon flesh in small amounts, and it makes a useful gentle alternative to the more intensely sweet cantaloupe. The preparation steps are identical: rind off, seeds out, flesh cut into small cubes, and any uneaten piece removed promptly.
        </p>
        <p>
          Keep portions to one or two cubes once a week at most, introduce it gradually the first time, and never feed the rind, seeds or any processed melon product. As with all fruit, honeydew belongs on top of a diet built firmly on hay, with fresh vegetables and leafy greens providing the daily nutritional foundation.
        </p>
